title: Reading Drill — A New Label for Community Gardens
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A New Label for Community Gardens
passages.body:
**A** A garden network made signs showing which beds were open for communal harvest. At first they used colour only, which was difficult to interpret when several signs had faded.

**B** Volunteers added an open-hand symbol and an explanation in two languages. They positioned signs next to the relevant beds, rather than making visitors match a code to a map.

**C** The updated signs included a space for the expected harvest date. A pencil could be used on that area, making it easier to mark a change after bad weather.

questions.explanation: At first they used colour only, which was difficult to interpret when several signs had faded.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: A pencil could be used on that area, making it easier to mark a change after bad weather.

questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: Volunteers added an open-hand symbol and an explanation in two languages. They positioned signs next to the relevant beds, rather than making visitors match a code to a map.

questions.explanation: The updated signs included a space for the expected harvest date. A pencil could be used on that area, making it easier to mark a change after bad weather.
